note: native application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: File/Edit/Selection/View/Go/Run/Terminal/Help
activity bar and status bar icons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run, Extensions, Accounts, Settings
editor chrome -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: tab action buttons (close, split, more); subtracts user-named file tabs, breadcrumbs, and file content
status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary: editor mode, EOL, encoding, indentation, screen reader mode; subtracts dynamic values like host, problem counts, and selection stats
